title: Wildflowers
notes:
Issued in single pocket jacket, with 12"×12" printed insert with lyrics and credits.

Catalog number 9 45759-1 on jacket, insert; 1-45759 on labels.

Runouts are etched, RB and Precision on all four sides. DMM = Direct Metal Mastering.

Identifying this version:
1. "℗1994 Warner Bros. Records Inc." at the bottom of each label preceded by a small gap below publisher.

2. Each side starts with track 1; tracks are not sequentially numbered.

Labels: Gone Gator Music ASCAP except A4, B4 Gone Gator Music/Wild Gator Music ASCAP.

Insert: All Songs © 1994 Gone Gator Music ASCAP Except track A4 and track B4 © 1994 Gone Gator Music/Wild Gator Music ASCAP.

Recorded in Los Angeles, CA at Sound City and Ocean Way Recording. Mixed at Andora Studios. Mastered at Precision Mastering.
